name: cloud.proxi.job.v23.ProxiJobV23Service
description: Android starts this Proxi.cloud service when one of its scheduled background tasks is due. Older SDK releases use it to run the saved task; in SDK 3.0.14, starting it has no visible effect.
disableEffect: Blocking it can stop scheduled Proxi.cloud updates and uploads in older releases; the app's ordinary screens remain available.
